cd /workspace && echo '{"version":1,"seed":0,"low_count":1,"attempts":1,"spacing_ms":1,"timeout_ms":1,"windows":[]}' > tmp/t/work/empty.json && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random, ipaddress
rng = random.Random(5)
DOC = int(ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8::/32').network_address)
out = open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/unknown_stress.jsonl','w')
size = 0
for i in range(300000):
    a = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(DOC + rng.getrandbits(112)))
    b = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(DOC + rng.getrandbits(112)))
    row = {"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":i,"target":a,"source":b,"type":129,"code":0}
    s = json.dumps(row, separators=(',',':'))
    out.write(s+'\n'); size += len(s)+1
out.close()
print(size)
EOF
time python3 submission/ipv6_replay.py replay tmp/t/work/empty.json tmp/t/work/unknown_stress.jsonl | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['accepted_rows'], d['duplicate_rows'], len(d['diagnostics']), len(d['segments']))"
